prompt:
Use the first reference image for the main character design: the middle fatty beef roll character (deep red marbled beef with creamy white fat swirls rolled into a cylinder, googly eyes with white eyeballs and black pupils, small simple mouth with no teeth, tiny stubby arms and short legs made of pale pink-white beef fat). In this shot it has THAWED: no frost, no ice, glistening fresh raw meat. Use the second reference image for the scene: the same single big round dark iron hotpot (no dividers) full of glossy red chili oil broth at a rolling boil, the same wooden table, bowls of chilies and peppercorns, warm tungsten lantern-lit Chongqing restaurant background, and the same chili and Sichuan peppercorn characters (googly eyes, small toothless mouths, tiny arms). New scene, vertical 9:16, camera about 40 degrees above, wide framing showing about 90% of the pot including the round rim and both handles. A pair of long wooden chopsticks lies across the pot from rim to rim like a diving board, extending a bit over the broth. The beef roll character stands on the far end of the chopsticks over the bubbling broth like a nervous diver: knees trembling, tiny arms held up in front of its chest, peeking down at the red broth with wide worried googly eyes and a small wobbly mouth, a drop of sweat on its side. Below, in the broth, the chili and peppercorn characters look up at it and cheer: arms raised, mouths open shouting, one chili waving both arms, three peppercorns jumping. Steam rising around the beef roll. Photorealistic textures, glistening oil highlights, warm red and amber tones, cute food-character animation in a photorealistic style, appetizing, film grain. No humans, no human hands, no text, no logos.
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。
